title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of Education of Critical Foreign Languages
title_original: 특수외국어 교육 진흥에 관한 법률 시행령

metadata.completion_statement: All eight articles and both addenda of the held Korean decree are translated in full. The held English main text is reused, with the missing Article 4(5) amendment notation and 2016 addendum supplied; the 2019 addendum is retained. Amendment tags identify the correct Presidential Decree, and two English grammatical errors are corrected. The separately supplied annex is translated as its own component.
